verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
The sun cannot compare
To the glory of Your love
There is no shadow in Your presence

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
No mortal man would dare
To stand before Your throne
Before the Holy One of heaven

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
It's only by Your blood
It's only through Your mercy
Lord I come

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I bring an offering of worship
To my King
No one on earth deserves
The praises that I sing

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Jesus may You receive
The honour that You're due
O Lord I bring an offering to You

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Over the skies of Bethlehem
Appeared a star
While angels sang to lowly shepherds

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Three wisemen seeking truth,
They traveled from afar
Hoping to find the Child from Heaven

verse.name: p2
verse.lines:
Falling on their knees
They bow before the humble
Prince of peace

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
We bring an offering of worship
To our King
No one on earth deserves
The praises that we sing

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
Jesus, may You receive
The honor that You're due
O Lord, I bring an offering to You
